Free Coinglass Alternative

Honest comparison · everything on the MarginPad side is free

If you use Coinglass mainly for liquidation maps, funding rates, open interest and the long/short ratio, MarginPad gives you that core set completely free, with no account — plus a real-time liquidation feed aggregated from 9 exchanges and a free JSON API for the same data. Coinglass remains the deeper research platform; this page shows exactly what you get free here and what still needs a paid plan there.

Side-by-side

FeatureMarginPad (free)Coinglass

The honest summary: Coinglass is the better pure-research terminal — longer history, more exchanges per metric, institutional tooling. MarginPad is the better free daily driver — the core derivatives dashboard plus a paper-trading terminal to actually act on what you see, and a keyless API to build with.

FAQ

Is MarginPad really a free alternative to Coinglass?

For the core derivatives dashboard — liquidation maps and heatmap, a live liquidation feed, funding rates, open interest, long/short ratio, ETF flows and a Hyperliquid whale tracker — yes, MarginPad is free with no account. Coinglass goes deeper on historical research and multi-exchange granularity, which is what its paid plans are for.

Where does MarginPad liquidation data come from?

MarginPad runs its own collector subscribed to the public liquidation websockets of 9 exchanges (Binance, Bybit, OKX, Hyperliquid, Gate, HTX, dYdX, BitMEX, Bitfinex), and aggregates per-coin 24h totals from Coinglass. Real events and estimates are always labelled separately.

Does MarginPad have a free liquidation API?

Yes — /api/v1/liquidations/recent, /api/v1/liquidations/live and /api/v1/clusters are keyless, CORS-enabled JSON endpoints at 60 requests/minute. Documentation at marginpad.io/free-crypto-api/.

What does Coinglass do better?

Deeper multi-year history, more granular per-exchange breakdowns, options data and institutional research tooling. If you need those, Coinglass paid plans are worth it — MarginPad covers the live day-to-day view for free.
